name: TwinOR
description: Developing embodied AI for intelligent surgical systems requires safe, controllable environments for continual learning and evaluation. However, safety regulations and operational constraints in operating rooms (ORs) limit agents from freely perceiving and interacting in realistic settings. Digital twins provide high-fidelity, risk-free environments for exploration and training. How we may create dynamic digital representations of ORs that capture relevant spatial, visual, and behavioral complexity remains an open challenge.
